name: kanban_add
description: Add a card to the board. Returns the whole board plus the new card's id as a top-level card_id, so the caller can act on the card immediately. Announces itself in the board's chatroom so other clankers can decide whether to act.
llm_description: Add a card to the shared kanban board; returns the whole board (new card's id included); announces in the board room. {"title"} required (max 512 chars); optional "column" (defaults backlog), "priority" (low|normal|high), "body", "assignee", "deadline" (unix secs), "labels", "goal", "room" (defaults 'board').

column.description: Column id, e.g. backlog, ready, doing, review, done. Defaults to backlog.

assignee.description: Instance name to put the card on at creation; omit to leave unassigned

labels.description: Initial label set for the card

goal.description: Goal id (state/goals.json) to link this card to

completion_criterion.description: Measurable completion criterion when this card is a goal

proof.description: Test script or artifact that proves the criterion (path or command)

stop_rule.description: When to abandon the goal attempt

worktree.description: Git worktree (branch/path) this goal belongs to

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
